rss: Stock up on food to prepare for extreme weather, minister says
title: Toy Bricks Shortage Due to Storms
story: Big storms might make it hard to get toy bricks. Kids might want to grab some now before the storm season.
storyBig: Expected extreme weather conditions are predicted to disrupt the supply chains for toy bricks. This might lead to a shortage in stores, increasing demand and prices.
think: What would happen if toy bricks aren't available for a while?
bull: It's a great time to enjoy building with what you have.
bear: Toy bricks might become more expensive or hard to find.

rss: Hospitality and education boosts US job creation in August
title: New Jobs Bring Fun New Products
story: Lots of new jobs were added in August. This means there might be more exciting new products for kids soon!
storyBig: A significant increase in job creation could lead to more innovative products in the market, as companies have more human resources to drive growth.
think: How can new jobs lead to new toys and games?
bull: More jobs can mean more ideas and products for kids.
bear: Not all new jobs might directly affect kids' markets.
